prompt: Vintage engraved woodcut-style illustration in an old prospector's almanac, sepia ink cross-hatching on aged parchment. A wide river fills the scene, crowded with hundreds of tiny miniature shop storefronts and market stalls floating like pebbles. In the foreground right, a large round gold-panning pan is tipped and sifting, so that only three gleaming gold nuggets remain at the bottom of the pan, glowing. Limited colour: gold on the nuggets and a muted teal on the water, everything else sepia. Wide 2:1 composition. The left third of the canvas stays quiet and low-detail so a title can be placed there. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, people or robots.
